sources.title: Tissue-contrastive semi-masked autoencoders for segmentation ...
sources.snippet: They added a momentum encoder to the online MAE, which takes whole images as inputs to generate feature embeddings for contrastive learning against their online masked counterparts. This contrastive dual-encoder setup enables the capture of both holistic and local discriminative features, thus achieving better generalization performance.

sources.title: Contrastive Tuning: A Little Help to Make Masked Autoencoders Forget
sources.snippet: Contrastive tuning (CT) aims to imitate fine-tuning in the absence of labeled training samples. MAE-CT utilizes a contrastive objective to guide a pre-trained MAE encoder to forget about the masked pixel-level MAE pre-training objective and to form object-focused semantic clusters.
